messages.subject: Error in as.vector(x, "character") : cannot coerce type 'closure' to vector of type 'character'
parts:
I am attempting to analyse SRM DDA data, carrying out a comparison of good and poor prognosis patient samples. I keep getting the following error when trying to carry out dataProcess with TMP:

Getting the summarization by Tukey's median polish per subplot for protein  A8K486 ( 1  of  30 )
Error in as.vector(x, "character") : 
  cannot coerce type 'closure' to vector of type 'character'

This happens to the next protein if I delete all transitions for this protein. I also have manually checked all transitions and have intensity values in all the rows. I do have a warning that MSstats was built under a previous version of R. Following are the lines I enter and I have attached the corresponding screenshots. 

setwd("C://Users/Erin/Documents/Cassie Melanoma biomarker SRM/MSstats")

getwd() 

mydata = read.csv("MSstatsInputAll3.csv", header=T)

head(mydata)

dataProcess(mydata, logTrans=2, normalization=FALSE, nameStandards=NULL,betweenRunInterferenceScore=FALSE, address="MstatsAll3_",fillIncompleteRows=TRUE,featureSubset="all",remove_proteins_with_interference=FALSE,summaryMethod="TMP",equalFeatureVar=TRUE,filterLogOfSum=TRUE,censoredInt="NA",cutoffCensored="minFeature",MBimpute=TRUE,original_scale=FALSE,logsum=FALSE,remove50missing=FALSE,skylineReport=FALSE)



Any help on this function would be much appreciated, I am new to R, so hopefully I am just making a simple rookie error.


Regards,
Erin Sykes

Hi Erin,

Can you try if you can process the data by removing the protein A8K486? 

mydata_1 <- mydata[mydata$ProteinName != "A8K486", ]
dataProcess(mydata_1)

Also, it may be worth taking a look at this protein: 

head(mydata[mydata$ProteinName == "A8K486", ])

Best,
Tsung-Heng
